source_class: user physical measurements of front-glass/visible-area geometry, resolved by absolute Y1/Y2 measurements from one common top-glass reference edge

superseded_measurements.values: T=3 mm, B=7 mm, visible height 66/67 mm
superseded_measurements.reason: Separate measurements used ambiguous/different visual boundaries and did not arithmetically close against the 75 mm glass height. They are retained only as historical evidence and are superseded by the common-reference Y1/Y2 measurement.

bezel_design_note: The visible-window datum is now physically reconciled. Final cosmetic bezel overlap/reveal may intentionally cover some inactive border, but must not crop the 110 x 67 mm locked visible window unless a later deliberate industrial-design decision says otherwise.
